'''July 2000 Centerville tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Schumers Cards and Comics, Centerville, Ohio on 8 July 2000. [[Frank Lamantia]] won it. It is known from Frank Lamantia's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d990">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-10-centerville-ohio-7-8-00d990/ centerville-ohio-7-8-00], DeckTech (Frank "FrankLamanti" Lamantia, 10 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-10-centerville-ohio-7-8-00d990/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 July 2000
* '''Site:''' Schumers Cards and Comics, Centerville, Ohio
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 9
* '''Winner:''' [[Frank Lamantia]]
